comments.text: A lot of the fears expressed here aren't as bad as you'd think, especially when it comes to shared experiences. Currently VR offers many different ways to watch content, however many people choose to arguably experience that content in lower quality with more noise and potential lag purely so they can experience it with other people in apps like VRChat or BigScreen. The desire for people to have shared experiences and the ability to do so won't disappear with AR and VR glasses, it will instead make the world even more connected and make it far easier to have shared experiences with other people. At the same time, those people that are more introverted and don't want to be surrounded by other people will also have a safe space of their own to relax if wanted.
